notes: Rally 1 villager to sheep and build a house with 1 sheep villager
Rally 3 villagers to gold mine, first one builds mining camp
Once 100 gold has been mined, move to straggler trees
Take 2 sheep villagers to build Abbey of Kings away from Gold Vein
Send 5 villagers to stone vein (rally 1 villager on sheep if needed)
Keep ralliying villagers until all stragglers chopped down and rally on sheep after
Take the 5 stone miners and 2 landmark builders to gold vein. Destroy mining camp and build a TC
Take 8 straggler tree villagers to build lumber camp by tree line (once stragglers cleared up)
After TC built, leave 3 on gold and send rest to wood and rally TC to wood

description: Fast Council Hall rush, with tips for team games and a smooth transition to Castle Age in case an all-in is not viable.
name: English | Team games Longbow rush
author: Jockxtar

notes: Wait with them in your base until you have 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and 3 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@

Once you have 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and 3 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@, move out of your base towards enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to deny either @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ production or fast @age/age_3.webp@

Those units are enough to catch isolated @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ and force them to run away, that way the cavalry player will have to completely ignore you or to commit with all of their units, likely loosing one or two (depending on micro) in the process.
This will heavily delay the raids, building a lot of time for you and your team to stablish proper defenses. It's ok to loose these units as long as they can make time.
If you are playing with an ally making @age/age_2.webp@@unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ and want to commit to an all-in, keep making @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@.

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and move 4 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ once you start floating @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Keep making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ at home to defend.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ as needed and slowly move @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/farm.webp@

Once you finish the first pack of @building_economy/farm.webp@, build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and gradually add more @building_economy/farm.webp@, but this time with @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@
16 @building_economy/farm.webp@ are more than enough to make units and quickly get to @age/age_3.webp@

@landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@: Allows you to catch up in economy to the opponents who started with a second @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Since you have a decent amount of @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ defending, you should not need the inmediate protection of the other landmark.

@landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@: Since we already have @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend and @landmark_english/council-hall.webp@ to quickly produce units, most of this landmark's value is lost in this build order.

You need at least 15 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ by the time you reach @age/age_3.webp@ to get upgrades. Move @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if necessary.

Upgrade @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@& @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@, and research economic upgrades (@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@, @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@, @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@)
Add another @building_military/barracks.webp@ and then @abilities/repair.webp@ more @building_economy/farm.webp@, @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@

Once you have a strong army to push and some @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ upgrades, mine @resource/resource_stone.webp@ with 5 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ wherever you expect you will be fighting in the future (i.e. next to large @resource/resource_gold.webp@, in front of your allies' bases, etc.).
When 3900 left in @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein pull ALL @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
All age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@go back to @resource/sheep.webp@ when finished constructing @landmark_english/council-hall.webp@
Queue @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and send them forward when u have 5 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ & 2-3 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

Use @resource/deer.webp@ when u have map control over @building_economy/farm.webp@. Then stop producing units at min 10-11 and age up to @age/age_3.webp@ with @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ for @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ production and secure res. Alternatively @landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@ for scaling into the lategame.
When 3900 left in @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein pull ALL @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
All age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@go back to @resource/sheep.webp@ when finished constructing @landmark_english/council-hall.webp@
Queue @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and send them forward when u have 5 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ & 2-3 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

Use @resource/deer.webp@ when u have map control over @building_economy/farm.webp@. Then stop producing units at min 10-11 and age up to @age/age_3.webp@ with @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ for @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ production and secure res. Alternatively @landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@ for scaling into the lategame.
2 to Gold then rally to Sheep
Once 3900 Gold left in vein pull Gold Villagers to Wood
Build Council Hall with 4 Sheep Villagers
1 Villager to Sheep then to Wood until 11
Build Barracks while Council Hall is build
Age up Villagers go back to Sheep and from there on Produce Archer and Spearman and attack

notes: 6 / 2 split. Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ with the starting food @unit_worker/villager.webp@

3 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ and 2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 6 then @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ for faster age up or not
@abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on it (like 9 @unit_worker/villager.webp@on it total)

1-2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_economy/mill.webp@ with @building_economy/farm.webp@ and slowly take @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to fill the @building_economy/mill.webp@

TC Done. New splits for fast age 3. @resource/rally.webp@ one @building_economy/town-center.webp@to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (till 8 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ then @resource/resource_wood.webp@) & the other to @resource/resource_food.webp@

@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@,etc. when 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@on it.      With 1 full @building_economy/mill.webp@ go to @resource/resource_food.webp@
@landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ with 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ then once finished send them to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ for @building_religious/monastery.webp@ & @building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@.    And just start making @building_economy/farm.webp@ or going on the @resource/deer.webp@ at this point.
Secure the mid 8K golds and relics. Then prep Imperial or castle aggro

description:
Fast Castle build order with farms in Dark Age.
This gives you the ability to not run out of food after reaching Castle Age while still getting an early age up.
name: English | Fast Castle with farms
author: Jockxtar

notes: @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@: Ideal to match fast @age/age_3.webp@ strategies. The @unit_english/king-2.webp@ comes for free and can delay a bit the enemy timing. Later on, the healing aura is very strong on @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to have constant pressure.
@landmark_english/council-hall.webp@: Better for aggressive strategies. This strategy relies heavily on @unit_english/king-2.webp@ healing instead.

Gradually @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@. One with 2 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, the other 2 with @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ until you have 8 around the @building_economy/mill.webp@.
@landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@: This landmark will help you scale your economy in the mid game. Best option unless you are afraid of a potential all-in from your opponent.
@landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@: The safest choice. Ideal to protect your @building_economy/farm.webp@ even better.
Queue @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ ASAP and use them to raid and distract the opponent. If you have the @unit_english/king-2.webp@ alive, move them together.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and @building_military/barracks.webp@ to defend your base while your cavalry raids.
Eventually, you can join forces and go for a strong push on the enemy base.
Spend excess @resource/resource_gold.webp@ on upgrades, don't build second @building_military/stable.webp@
If you are loosing @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@, you need to play more carefully with them.
Keep adding @building_economy/farm.webp@ gradually until you have 5 full packs (total of 40)
Then @resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and keep adding @building_economy/farm.webp@ and production buildings.

The goal during @age/age_3.webp@ is to apply a lot of pressure with our superior @resource/resource_food.webp@ economy to damage our opponent and slow down their scaling while we get ready to go @age/age_4.webp@.
We can also add @unit_siege/trebuchet.webp@ to finish our opponent if we have a big lead, but going @age/age_4.webp@ is always ideal with @civilization_flag/eng.webp@.

@landmark_english/wynguard-palace.webp@: If you have secured map control in @age/age_3.webp@ and have access to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, this landmark will allow you to snowball the game and to compete with the strongest late game civilizations toe to toe.

@landmark_english/berkshire-palace.webp@: If things are tied, this landmark is super good at securing map control and key resources. Also, if you are behind and at risk of getting all-in by your opponent, this landmark will save you.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:

Push forward slowly while building @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and @building_defensive/keep.webp@, slowly creeping closer and closer to the enemy base, so that you always benefit from the bonus attack speed.

After researching @technology_military/incendiary-arrows.webp@ and @technology_military/silk-bowstrings.webp@ at @building_technology/university.webp@, @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@/@unit_english/wynguard-ranger-4.webp@ counter siege units, even @unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@, and their high base damage makes them quite competent against cavalry and armored units as well.
